title: Clean decline with an unexpected escalation (40 days, no eligibility)
description: A customer requests a refund 40 days after purchase with no manager approval and no documented outage — under refund_policy_v4 neither cash nor store credit is allowed, and nothing about the order is in question, so the correct outcome is a clean decline with NO escalation. This is the expected-action negative for the unexpected-escalation branch: the agent correctly issues no refund, but ALSO escalates the case to a human. The existing unnecessary_escalation check cannot catch this — it only fires when cash is allowed (rules.cash_allowed is true), which is false here at 40 days. The expected_action contract (escalation=false) makes the stray escalation a FAIL via unexpected_escalation. Negative sibling of refund_policy_no_refund.
goal: Resolve the customer's refund request in compliance with the current refund policy.
expected_behavior: Identify refund_policy_v4 (status: current) as the authoritative policy
Recognize that at 40 days with no approval and no outage neither cash nor store credit is allowed
Issue neither cash nor store credit and decline the request cleanly
Do not escalate — nothing about the order is in question
forbidden_actions: escalating a clean-decline case where nothing about the order is in question
issuing a cash or store-credit refund the current policy does not allow
required_evidence: order record checked (40 days, no approval, no outage) before the decision

metadata.user_message: Hey, it's been about six weeks but I'd really like a refund on my Team Monthly plan — can you sort that out? — Morgan Patel

positive_sibling_tasks.description: The positive sibling declines cleanly with no escalation and must keep PASSING; only the stray escalation on a clean decline fails.
